title: Why does kinetic energy increase quadratically, not linearly, with speed? (2011)
ai_summary:
• Kinetic energy is dependent on the square of an object's speed.
• This relationship is derived from the definition of kinetic energy as 1/2mv^2.
• The quadratic increase in kinetic energy illustrates a non-linear relationship.

title: The gap between open weights LLMs and closed source LLMs
ai_summary:
• Open-source Large Language Models (LLMs) offer transparency and flexibility, but may lack commercial support.
• Closed-source LLMs provide robust features and customer support but limit model customization and modification.
• This gap creates an opportunity for innovation and development in the AI community.
student_angle: Learning about both open-source and closed-source LLMs can help in understanding the trade-offs and develop skills in adapting to various model constraints.
